scripts.dev: concurrently --names worker,frontend -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter osrs-spawn-map-worker dev" "pnpm --filter osrs-spawn-map-frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter osrs-spawn-map-worker typecheck && pnpm --filter osrs-spawn-map-frontend build
scripts.check: uv sync && pnpm -r format:check && pnpm -r lint:check && pnpm -r test && pnpm build && pnpm check:scraper
scripts.check:scraper: uv sync && uv run ruff check scraper && uv run ruff format --check scraper && uv run ty check && uv run pytest -q
